connector.name: MCP Sam Gov
connector.registryDescription: Keyless MCP: 150 tools for US federal + state/local (SLED) contracting, spending & regulation
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-sam-gov. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cliwant account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SAM_GOV_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. SAM.gov key for higher rate limits + archives older than 12 months. Keyless by default.

env.name: CENSUS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free key for Census business-patterns tools.

env.name: FRED_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free key for FRED economic-series tools.

env.name: BEA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free key for BEA regional/industry economic tools.

env.name: BLS_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free key for BLS labor-statistics tools (raises rate limits).

env.name: DOL_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free key for DOL data-endpoint tools.

env.name: DATA_GOV_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free api.data.gov key (raises DEMO_KEY limits for DOL/govinfo tools).

env.name: NVD_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free NVD key (raises CVE rate limits).

env.name: OPENFDA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional free openFDA key (raises rate limits).

env.name: SOCRATA_APP_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Socrata app token (raises rate limits on SLED Socrata hosts).

env.name: COURTLISTENER_API_TOKEN
env.description: Optional CourtListener (Free Law Project) token (raises rate limits).

env.name: LDA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Senate LDA lobbying-disclosure key (raises rate limits).

env.name: EDGAR_USER_AGENT
env.description: Optional SEC EDGAR User-Agent string (courtesy identification; a sensible default is used otherwise).
